failureRate.description: Probability that one executed query fails. Units: %. Canonical value (probability from 0 to 1): >= 0 and <= 1; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
failureRate.title: Failure rate

processing.description: Execution time of one database query. Initially exponential with a mean of 5ms.

kind.description: Choose fixed for a constant duration, exponential for independent random durations, or lognormal for a long tail of slow operations.
kind.title: Distribution

mean.description: Use the measured average, not p95 or p99. It sets the scale of the chosen distribution. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
mean.title: Mean

stdDev.description: For lognormal only: use the measured standard deviation. Larger values produce more variation. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): > 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.

queue.description: Waiting queries. 0 means no queue: when all connections are busy, a query is rejected immediately. Initially 0.

maxClientConnections.description: Concurrent client connections; excess attempts are rejected immediately. Initially 1000.
maxClientConnections.title: Maximum client connections

poolSize.description: Concurrent server connections held through local delay and the outgoing call. Initially 20.
poolSize.title: Server pool size

processing.description: Local delay after acquiring a server connection, before the outgoing call. Initially fixed at 0.1ms.
processing.title: Pooler delay

waitTimeout.description: Maximum FIFO wait for a server connection. 0 means no waiting: if no server connection is free, the attempt is rejected immediately. Initially 5s. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
waitTimeout.title: Server connection wait timeout

processing.description: Local processing time of one attempt. Initially exponential with a mean of 10ms.

oneOf.title: Service

oneOf.description: Synchronous call with a per-attempt timeout, retries and backoff on the caller side.

attempts.description: Maximum attempts including the first one.
attempts.title: Attempts

base.description: Delay after the first failed attempt before jitter. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
base.title: Base delay

kind.description: Fixed uses the base delay, capped by the maximum. Exponential pauses choose a random value from zero to the current limit; the multiplier sets how that limit changes.
kind.title: Kind

max.description: Upper bound of one backoff delay. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
max.title: Maximum delay

balancing.description: Choose how attempts are distributed across the target replicas. The default is round robin.
balancing.title: Balancing

failureRate.description: Open when the failure share reaches this threshold after the minimum number of completed attempts. Units: %. Canonical value (probability from 0 to 1): >= 0 and <= 1; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
failureRate.title: Failure threshold

halfOpenCalls.description: Maximum number of probe attempts. Their completed failure share decides whether to close or reopen.
halfOpenCalls.title: Half-open calls

minimumCalls.description: Completed attempts required before evaluating the failure share; no greater than the window size.
minimumCalls.title: Minimum calls

openDuration.description: Time before allowing half-open probes; rejected attempts use no pool, network or target work. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): > 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
openDuration.title: Open duration

window.description: Number of most recent completed attempts in the closed-state window. Breaker rejections are excluded.
window.title: Window size

circuitBreaker.description: Reject attempts locally while open. Each calling instance keeps its own count-based window.
circuitBreaker.title: Circuit breaker

on.description: Final failure reasons replaced by the fallback; deadline is excluded.
on.title: Failure reasons

processing.description: Time spent on the calling handler before continuing the scenario, bounded by the original deadline. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
processing.title: Fallback processing time

fallback.description: Replace a matching final call failure after all attempts. Successful originals with a fallback count as degraded.
fallback.title: Fallback

kind.description: Choose fixed for a constant duration, exponential for independent random durations, or lognormal for a long tail of slow operations.
kind.title: Distribution

mean.description: Use the measured average, not p95 or p99. It sets the scale of the chosen distribution. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
mean.title: Mean

stdDev.description: For lognormal only: use the measured standard deviation. Larger values produce more variation. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): > 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
stdDev.title: Standard deviation

network.description: One-way network delay, drawn separately for the request and the response. Initially fixed at 1ms.
network.title: Network delay

acquireTimeout.description: Maximum wait for a free connection, also bounded by the remaining deadline. 0 means no waiting: if no connection is free, the attempt fails immediately. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
acquireTimeout.title: Acquisition timeout

size.description: Maximum simultaneous connections for this call on each caller instance. Initially 10 when the pool is enabled.
size.title: Pool size

pool.description: Slots owned by the calling instance, held until response or attempt timeout.
pool.title: Connection pool

minPerSecond.description: Additional allowance multiplied by the window duration; it is available even with no first attempts. Units: /ms, /s, /min. Canonical value (requests per millisecond): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
minPerSecond.title: Minimum retries per second

ratio.description: Maximum retries per first attempt within the window. Units: %. Canonical value (probability from 0 to 1): >= 0 and <= 1; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
ratio.title: Retry ratio

window.description: Age after which first attempts and retries leave the budget. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): > 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
window.title: Budget window

retryBudget.description: Bound retries by a share of first attempts plus a minimum allowance over a rolling time window.
retryBudget.title: Retry budget

retryTarget.description: Another replica prefers a replica or routing target not yet tried by this request; once all have been tried, any may be reused.
retryTarget.title: Retry target

timeout.description: Per-attempt timeout, also bounded by the remaining deadline. Initially 1s. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): > 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
timeout.title: Timeout

oneOf.title: Call

oneOf.description: Delivers original requests from the client to the entry service without delay or retries.
oneOf.title: Request

oneOf.description: One router output to a callable block.

weight.description: Positive output weight used only by random routing.
weight.title: Weight

failureRate.title: Failure rate

kind.title: Distribution

mean.description: Use the measured average, not p95 or p99. It sets the scale of the chosen distribution. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): >= 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
mean.title: Mean

stdDev.description: For lognormal only: use the measured standard deviation. Larger values produce more variation. Units: ms, s, min. Canonical value (milliseconds): > 0; numeric bounds are checked by the core.
stdDev.title: Standard deviation

processing.description: Local processing time of one attempt. Initially exponential with a mean of 10ms.
processing.title: Processing time
